lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized in approximately 10-12 visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Each column contains 4-6 distinct nodes, forming a regular grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal alignment of the circular blobs, positioning the blobs at the vertices of a grid formed by vertical and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, characterized by high-luminance highlights on the superior edge and sharp shadow gradients on the inferior edge, running parallel to the shark's midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a low-density distribution of irregularly shaped, low-contrast light patches, primarily concentrated along the anterior margin and the lower half of the fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct notch or indentation is visible on the posterior (trailing) margin of the first dorsal fin. Several irregular white patches are visible on the distal posterior edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately five smaller teleost fish (likely remoras) are visible in the water column directly ventral to the shark's mid-body.
